<entry id="V01011">
<head-word>תָּרַם</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of תְּרוּמָה) 
<italic>to lift</italic>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to remove</italic> (
<italic>ashes</italic>), 
<italic>clear the altar</italic> (Lev. VI, 3).</definition>
<notes> Yoma II, 1 בראשונה כל מי שרוצה לִתְרוֹם … תּוֹרֵם formerly whosoever wanted to remove the ashes from the altar, could do it. Ib. 2 התקינו שלא יהו תוֹרְמִין וכ' it was arranged that they should clean the altar only by lot. Y. ib. 39
<sup>b</sup> bot. זר שת' if an outsider removed the ashes. Tam. I, 2; 4; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to separate the priestly gift, to make T’rumah</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ter. I, 1 חמשה לא יִתְרוֹמוּ ואם תָּרְמוּ וכ' five persons should not make T’rumah, and if they did &c., v. תְּרוּמָה. Ib. התּוֹרֵם את שאינו שלו he that separates T’rumah from what does not belong to him. Ib. נכרי שת' את של ישראל if a gentile makes T’rumah of what belongs to an Israelite. Ib. 4 אין תורמין זיתים על השמן וכ' you cannot consecrate olives as T’rumah for oil, or grapes for wine. Ib. 5 אין תורמין מן הלקט וכ' you are not bound to give the priestly share out of the gleanings &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="V01015">
<head-word>תַּרְמִיל</head-word>
<head-word>תַּרְמֵל</head-word>
<head-word>תּוּרְ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (
<italic>leather</italic>) 
<italic>bag</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 31
<sup>a</sup> גר … במקלו ובתַרְמִילוֹ the mean proselyte who came with nothing but his staff and travelling bag (I being without merit or ancestry). Y. Shebu. VIII, 38
<sup>c</sup> bot. כיון … ותרמילו עליה חייב as soon as he puts his staff and his bag on that animal, he becomes responsible; Tosef. B. Mets. VIII, 17. Sifra Metsorʿa, Zab., Par. 1, ch. II התורמל חמשת קבים a 
<italic>turmel</italic> is a bag of five Kabs capacity; Kel. XX, 1. Ib. XIX, 8 התו' שנפחת וכ' a bag the inside pocket of which has become defective. Tosef. Bets. III, 17 ולא הרועה בתרמילו neither dare the shepherd go out with his bag (on the Holy Day); a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>seed-bag, pod</italic>. Tosef. Shebi. II, 6 על מה נחלקו על הת' they differ concerning the laws of the Sabbatical year as applicable to plants in the stage of formation of pods, v. תִּרְמֵל.—
<plural-form>Pl. תּוּרְמְלִין</plural-form>. Kel. XXIV, 11 שלש ת' הן וכ' there are three kinds of bags (with regard to levitical cleanness): those having the standard capacity (five Kabs, v. supra).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="V01021">
<head-word>תַּרְנְגוֹל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (ת־רגל with anorganic נ, as תְּרוּנְגָּא for תְּרוֹגָא; v. Targ. Prov. XXX, 3</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>spurred,</italic>] 
<italic>cock, chicken</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 26
<sup>a</sup>, v. שֶׂכְוִי. Yoma 21
<sup>a</sup> ת' בינוני a normal cock (that crows neither too early nor too late). Snh. 98
<sup>b</sup>, v. עֲטַלֵּף. Ib. 63
<sup>b</sup>, v. נֵרְגַל. Tanḥ. Emor 2; Yalk. Sam. 139 אין כאן ת' שיקרא is there no cock here to crow (announcing the morning)? B. Mets. 86
<sup>b</sup> מובחר שבעופות ת' (some ed. תרנגולת) the choice of fowls is the chicken. Bekh. 8
<sup>a</sup> (of the 
<italic>hen</italic>); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. תַּרְנְגוֹלִים, תַּרְנְגוֹלִין</plural-form>. B. Mets. l. c. Tanḥ. l. c. B. Kam. VII, 7 אין מגדלין ת' וכ' no chickens were raised in Jerusalem. Taan. 25
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>d</sup> top אדומים (ת') red cocks. Ab. Zar. I, 5 מותר … תרנגול לבן בין הת' you may sell him (the gentile) a white cock along with other cocks (although he may use the white cock for idolatrous purposes). Yeb. 84
<sup>a</sup> כת' של בית בוקיא like the cocks of B. B. (that tolerate no intruder); a. fr.—[Y. Dem. II, 22
<sup>d</sup> top תרנגול קיסריין, v. תַּרְנְגוֹלָא II.]—
<italic>Fem.</italic> תַּרְנְגוֹלֶת 
<italic>hen</italic>. Snh. 63
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to סכות בנות, II Kings XVII, 30) מאי ניהו ת' what is this (deity)? A hen. Tosef. Makhsh. II, 15. Sabb. 67
<sup>b</sup>, v. גַּבְרִית; Tosef. ib. VI (VIII), 5; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="V01022">

<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Ps. L, 11, v. בַּר I ch.; a. fr.—Sabb. 78
<sup>a</sup> ת' ברא Ms. M. (ed. תרנגולת), v. בַּר I ch. Lev. R. s. 5 (ref. to גבר, Is. XXII, 17) כהדין ת' דהוה וכ' like the cock that moves about from place to place; Yalk. Is. 290. Yoma 20
<sup>b</sup> (expl. קריאת הגבר) קרא ת' the cock has crowed; Y. Succ. V, end, 55
<sup>c</sup> תרנוגלא; Y. Shek. V, 48
<sup>d</sup> bot.; a. fr.—
<italic>Fem.</italic> תַּרְנְגוֹלָא, תַּרְנְגוּלְתָּא. Gitt. 55
<sup>b</sup> אתרנגולא ות' חריב וכ' on account of a cock and a hen Ṭur Malka was destroyed. Lev. R. s. 25, v. שֶׂכְוִי; Yalk. ib. 615. Ib. הדה ת' כד וכ' as long as her chicks are small, the hen calls them together &c. Midr. Till. to Ps. XLV ת' ברא the hen of the prairie; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>T.</italic></definition>

<entry id="V01026">
<head-word>תָּרַס</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of תָּרִיס), 
<italic>Hif.</italic> הִתְרִיס </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to shield, protect</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. V, 7
<sup>b</sup> bot. (expl. לבובין) נותן … והוא מַתְרִיס כנגד חיה one places a hide from the tannery against its heart, and this protects it against attacks of wild beasts.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to resist, fight, wrestle in debate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 121
<sup>b</sup> שה' עם שמנים וכ' (ed. שהתירם, corr. acc.) who debated with eighty-five elders; Y. ib. XVI, 15
<sup>d</sup> שהיו מַתְרִיסִין כנגד וכ' who debated with R. H.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="V01027">
<head-word>תְּרַס</head-word>
<language-key> ch.,</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Af.</italic> אַתְרֵיס, 
<italic>Pa.</italic> תָּרֵיס same, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to shield</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XLI, 7 מַתְרִיסִין Var. ed. Lag. (ed. תְּרֵיסִין noun).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to fight, challenge, oppose</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41
<sup>b</sup> top ולא על יאות … מְתָרֵס לקיבליה but R. Ḥ. opposed him improperly; Y. Dem. III, 23
<sup>c</sup> bot. ולא עאל יאות … מַתְרִיס לקבל (corr. acc.). Y. Gitt. III, 44
<sup>d</sup> לא דריש לקיש מַתְרִיס לקבל וכ' not that R. L. opposed R. J. because they differed in theory, but &c. Tam. 32
<sup>a</sup> מה דין אַתְרִיסְתּוּן לקבלי (Rashi אִיתְרִ' 
<italic>Ithpe.</italic>) why, now, did you oppose me?</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to put on armor</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Kidd. III, 63
<sup>d</sup> והוה … מתרס כליו וכ' and R. Ḥ. put his armor on against (took up a debate with) &c.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְרִיס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same, 
<italic>to oppose</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 111
<sup>a</sup> השתא איכו נח … אִיתְרִיסַת לקבלי Ms. M. (ed. השתא כי) now if R. H. were dead, you might have opposed me (by referring to his authority).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="V01029">
<head-word>תָּרַע</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of תְּרוּעָה), 
<italic>Hif.</italic> הִתְרִיעַ 
<italic>to sound alarm</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to blow the Shofar at public services</italic> (at fast and prayer meetings &c.).</definition>
<notes> Y. Taan. II, 65
<sup>b</sup> top כל שנה שאין מַתְרִיעִין … שמתריעין לה בסופה if people neglect to blow the Shofar at the beginning of the year, they will sound it at the end, v. רוּעַ I. Taan. III, 1 צמחים ששנו מתריעין עליהם מיד when plants change (degenerate), we blow (call prayer meetings) for them at once (without waiting for the first rain). Ib. 3 אותה העיר מתענה ומַתְרַעַת … ומַתְרִיעוֹת that town must fast and blow the Shofar (at prayer meeting), and all those around must fast, but not hold prayer meetings; מתריעות ולא מתענות must hold prayer meetings, but not fast. Ib. 7 על אלו מתריעין בשבת וכ' on the following occasions the alarm is sounded on the Sabbath: when a city is surrounded by gentiles, or threatened with a flood, &c., v. טָרַף; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="V01030">
<head-word>תְּרַע</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>

<sense>
<definition> (

<italic>to break, shatter, make a breach</italic> (corresp. to h. פָּרַץ, a. נָתַץ).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Jdg. VI, 30. Ib. VIII, 9. Targ. II Sam. VI, 8; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. תְּרִיעַ; f. תְּרִיעָא 
<italic>broken into, open</italic>. Targ. Prov. XXV, 28.—Y. Peah I, 16
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Y. Shebu II, end, 33
<sup>c</sup>, a. e. ותַרְעִין וכ', v. סוּג I ch.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>תָּרַע, תַּרַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XLIX, 6 תָּרַעוּ ed. Berl. (ed. Vien. תַּרְעוּ). Targ. O. Lev. XIV, 45 ed. Berl. (ed. Vien. 
<italic>Pe.</italic>). Targ. Ps. II, 9 תְּתָרָעִי' Ms. (ed. 
<italic>Pe.</italic>); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְּרַע, אִתְתְּרַע, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be broken, shattered, be broken into</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. XXIX, 18 (h. text יפרע). Targ. Jer. XXXIX, 2. Targ. Jdg. VI, 28; a. fr.; v. רְעַע.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="V01031">
<head-word>תְּרַע</head-word>

<senses>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>opening</italic>,] 
<pgbrk id="pg1701" />
<italic>door, gate</italic> (corresp. to h. פֶּתח, a. שַׁעַר).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ex. XXXII, 27. Targ. Deut. XXII, 21; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 5
<sup>8</sup> ת' פתיחא if she finds the door open; ת' משקיף if she finds it shut. Num. R. s. 9
<sup>13</sup>, v. אָסֵי; a. fr.—[Yalk. Mic. 551, v. תַּרְעָיָיא.]—
<plural-form>Pl. תַּרְעִין, תַּרְעַיָּא, תַּרְעַיָּיה, תַּרְעֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Y. Deut. III, 5. Targ. Is. XXVI, 2. Targ. Prov. XXXI, 31; a. fr.—Y. Shek. V, end, 49
<sup>b</sup> ר' אבון עבד אילין ת' וכ' R. A. was building those gates of the Great College; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> = h. שַׁעַר 
<italic>market, market price</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 90
<sup>b</sup>, v. חֲרָפָא. B. Mets. 74
<sup>b</sup> בחד ת' when prices remain unchanged; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. as ab. Ib. בתרי ת'</plural-form> when there are two prices (prices have changed); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>תַּרְעוֹמֶת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (רָעַם) 
<italic>murmur, complaint, quarrel</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. VI, 1 אין להם … אלא ת' they have nothing but a complaint (no legal claim) against each other. Ib. 76
<sup>a</sup> ת' מאי עבידתיה what cause for complaint is there? [Answ. אמר ליה לית לך אל תמנע וכ' he may say to him, dost thou not believe in (Prov. III, 27), ‘withhold not a benefit &c.’?] Y. ib. V, 10
<sup>b</sup> המבטל כיס … אלא ת' if an agent leaves his neighbor’s money unemployed, the latter has no legal claim; ib. IX, beg. 12
<sup>a</sup>, opp. חייב לשפות. Sabb. 56
<sup>b</sup> לא עליך יש לי ת' וכ' (ed. תרעומות) I have no quarrel with thee, but only with him &c.; Yalk. Sam. 151. Treat. Der. Er. Zuṭṭa ch. IX, beg. התרחק מן הת' וכ' keep aloof from murmuring (talking against a fellowman), for if thou talkest against thy neighbor, thou wilt commit other sins too. Ber. 12
<sup>a</sup> בקשו … מפני ת' המינין they wanted to read so (recite the Ten Commandments with the Sh’mʿa in the prayers), had they not long ago abolished it on account of the seditious talk of the heretics (who declared nothing to be essential in the Law but the Ten Commandments); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. תַּרְעוּמוֹת</plural-form>. Tosef. Sot. VI, 1 ושאר כל הת' האמורות וכ' and all the other murmurings (against God) mentioned in that section (Job XXVII).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup> [read:] אית תניי תני ת' ואית תניי תני תרבות מאן … תרפים וכ' some read 
<italic>tarputh</italic>, and others read 
<italic>tarbuth</italic>; he that reads 
<italic>tarputh</italic> refers to 
<italic>t’rafim</italic> (תְּרָפִים 
<italic>obscenities</italic>, v. תּוֹרְפָה) &c., v. תּוֹרִיב. Tosef. l. c. 16 לא … עם שיירא בת' (our w. omitted in ed. Zuck.) a man (Jew) must not go with a party on an idolatrous pilgrimage. Bab. ib. 32
<sup>b</sup> נכרי ההולך לת' וכ' if a gentile is going to an idolatrous festival, you must not deal with him, because he goes to offer his devotion to idolatry, but on his way back you may deal with him &c.; ישראל ההולך לת' וכ' if a Jew is going to an idolatrous festival, you may deal with him on his way to it, for he may reconsider and not go &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<definition>
<italic>to make straight; to arrange, lead</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. III, 6 יְתָרֵץ (some ed. תָּרֵיץ Part. 
<italic>Pe.</italic>). Targ. Job XXXIII, 27 Ms. (ed. Wil. יִתְרִיץ; h. text יָשֹׁר!). Targ. Y. Ex. XXXIX, 33; a. e.—Targ. II Chr. XXIX, 34 תָּרֵיצוּ ed. Wil. (add.: לבא) they made their heart straight (ready; oth. ed. תְּרִיצֵי לבא were straight of heart; h. text ישרי לב).—Ber. 46
<sup>b</sup>, v. infra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (mentally) 
<italic>to set aright, settle, harmonize</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 4
<sup>b</sup> רבה מְתָרֵץ לטעמיה ורבא מתרץ וכ' Rabbah settles (explains the differences of opinion in the Mishnah) in accordance with his principle (so that both disputants agree with his principle), and Raba in accordance with his. B. Mets. 14
<sup>b</sup> לאו תָּרוּצֵי קא מְתָרְצַת תָּרֵיץ נמי בבעל חוב must you not (in order to uphold the Boraitha) explain it (that it refers to robbers)? explain it just as well that it refers to a creditor. Keth. 35
<sup>b</sup> היכי מְתָרֵיץ לה how will he harmonize the Mishnah (with his principle)? Sabb. 62
<sup>a</sup> תָּרְצַת אשה וכ' you have explained the case satisfactorily with regard to woman, what have you to say concerning the case of man? M. Kat. 13
<sup>b</sup>; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>

<binyan-form>אִתָּרֵיץ, </binyan-form>

<number>—2)</number>

<plural-form>Pl. תַּשְׁמִישִׁים, תַּשְׁמִישִׁין</plural-form>. <italic>copulation</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> כל שתַּשְׁמִישׁוֹ ביום all animals which copulate in day time; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
